Region, region*target, country, and country*target will account for no more than 8% of the total variance in ratings across traits (.08 summed ICC).

Experiment - A researcher randomly assigns treatments to study subjects, this includes field or lab experiments. This is also known as an intervention experiment and includes randomized controlled trials.
No blinding is involved in this study.

The data that we are analyzing did originally include manipulations of (a) crying, (b) situational valence, and c) social context. See https://osf.io/p62v8/ for details. Our analyses will not include any of these manipulations.
Registration prior to accessing the data

The data is not publicly accessible, but instead has been offered to us for replication by one of the reviewers of our manuscript. We will only gain access to the data after our preregistration is filed.
The data already exists. See https://osf.io/p62v8/ for more details.
